promptText: SHOT_ID: SHOT-001 REVISION_ID: rev-001 RUN_ID: flow-live-shot-001-20260915 Create exactly one polished cinematic 3D reference image for this shot, not a storyboard and not multiple images. Subject: the same primary dinosaur hero throughout the project: realistic anatomy, stable head and jaw silhouette, consistent skin pattern, dark charcoal-blue scales, physically believable proportions. Shot action: a close-up still of the dinosaur awakening in darkness, like a museum fossil or ancient artifact. A restrained cool blue light sweeps across one eye and the detailed skin texture. The camera is a slow, intimate push-in toward the face; keep the eye and facial scales as the focal point. Look: full CGI 3D cinematic, realistic materials, detailed scales, volumetric atmospheric haze, deep jungle green and charcoal background, cool blue rim light, controlled contrast, 16:9. Continuity: one hero only, no extra characters, preserve the same identity, proportions, materials, palette, and direction for later shots. Negative: no text, logo, watermark, collage, contact sheet, storyboard panels, duplicate subject, random props, gore, blood, broken anatomy, morphing, camera jump.
